first_checkpoint: Same recorded V3 episodes and original 20+20 update order, with loss only on useful steps in complete real windows. This changes evidence admission and its loss weighting; source experience is unchanged.
later_checkpoints: Test 100 and 200 total updates over the same recorded data, with the existing event/stage balancing and 2x correction-group weight.
interpretation: All ten actions and their pre-action observation are real. Only evidence-supported steps enter the seven-channel flow loss; failed/ambiguous actions remain known noisy input context, not loss targets. No unexecuted tails, new collection actions or new teacher calls. Development learner ablation; retain the source 620 controls and 4,152,587 tokens without duplicating global charges. Cross-step denoising attention still sees the noised known actions at unsupervised steps; this is an explicit limitation to test.
